messages:
lina: Quick FYI 0 we're going to emit a small 'debounce' event from the routing layer to help TTL/windowing for tenant quotas. It's non-billable but flows through the metering topic so attribution stays correct. tagging billing + eng-platform
pete: Can you paste the event shape so invoice-preview won't accidentally show it? need explicit billable flag and dedupe_key
lina: example payload: {"type":"route_debounce","tenant_id":"t-xyz","route_id":"r-ingest","id":"deb:edge-2:42","billable":false,"dedupe_key":"deb:edge-2:42","meta_tag":"debounce_mig"} 
ash: Strong requirement: invoice-staging must drop billable=false before any cost lookups or tokenization. console preview should hide these rows by default and show a small banner 'internal debounce events suppressed'
ops-bot: lina/debounce-migration canary deployed to edge-2 cluster 126-03-23T09:15Z
billing-bot: NOTICE: edge-2 observed +2.6% event volume vs baseline in 5m window (likely debounce warmup) - watching invoice-preview output
pete: Add a reconcile tool to scan ledger for dedupe_key starting with deb:* and flag rows for manual review in case any slipped through
lina: added script debounce-reconcile --from=2026-03-23T08:00Z --to=2026-03-23T10:00Z. Rollout plan: 0.5% tenant whitelist -> 5% -> 25% with a 1h observation at each step
ash: Dashboard requests: add card meter.debounce.count by route, and an alert if dedupe.collisions > 0. Also add a telemetry tag debounce_migration=2026-03-23 on emitted metrics
lina: Opening ENG-6210 with runbook, dashboard links, reconcile script, and tests for ledger/aggregation. Will update this thread after the 5% ramp. Thanks :thumbsup:
